Chase recently added a slew of new perks to its popular Sapphire Preferred credit card, including a free one-year Apple TV subscription or a discount on Apple One. Here are the details.

Chase Sapphire Preferred now offers a free year of Apple TV, with the option to use an Apple One credit instead

Apple TV has long been one of the exclusive perks for Chase Sapphire Reserve cardholders. However, that card carries a hefty annual fee of $795.

But Chase announced recently that Sapphire Preferred cardholders can now also get Apple TV for free.

Chase Sapphire Preferred is a travel-focused credit card with an annual fee of just $95 a year, making it far more affordable than the Reserve.

Sapphire Preferred cardholders must activate the offer by December 31, 2026 to enjoy the free year of Apple TV.

Both new and existing customers can take advantage of this offer by linking their Apple account to Chase through the Benefits portal in the Chase mobile app or website.

The one-year free Apple TV, worth $156 in total, joins a robust lineup of perks on the Sapphire Preferred.

For existing Apple One subscribers, Chase is also offering a $7.50 monthly credit as an alternative perk, making Apple's bundle of services an even better deal.

In the same way, by linking your Apple account to Chase, as long as you're subscribed to any Apple One plan, the credit will be applied automatically each month for up to 12 months.

So whether you're already subscribed to Apple One or are looking to sign up, you'll benefit from Chase's new perk.

Additionally, if you hold the higher-end Chase Sapphire Reserve card, since it already includes free Apple TV and Apple Music, as an Apple One subscriber you can now enjoy an extra $15 monthly credit. Previously, Apple One subscribers were essentially shut out of this reward.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or you can get a discount through the Apple One bundle.
